source_caption:
Adam Wingard returns with Onslaught, an action-horror thriller starring Adria Arjona, Rebecca Hall, Dan Stevens, Drew Starkey, Alex Pereira, and Michael Biehn. The film follows a former Army sniper forced to protect her young daughter after a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers escapes into the desert.

Known for You’re Next, The Guest, and Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire, Wingard reunites with longtime collaborator Simon Barrett for what promises to be a brutal mix of relentless action, horror, and practical thrills. With its stacked cast and high-energy premise, Onslaught is shaping up to be one of the most anticipated genre films of the year.

Onslaught arrives in IMAX and theaters on September 4.

source_details.title: Onslaught
source_details.synopsis: Onslaught is a 2026 American action horror film directed by Adam Wingard and written by Simon Barrett, starring Adria Arjona, Dan Stevens, Eric Wareheim, Reginald VelJohnson, Michael Biehn, Alex Pereira, Drew Starkey, and Rebecca Hall. Set in the same continuity as The Guest, the film follows an army sniper as she struggles to protect her young daughter from an army of genetically engineered super soldiers who escaped from a secret military facility. Onslaught was released in the United States by A24 on September 4, 2026. The film received mixed reviews from critics and has grossed $3.1 million against a $15 million budget, making it a box office disappointment.
